Name: Skill Rings REMIX Feat. Paint.net (Radio ver.)
Author: AtomicBunnytron
Description:
Hello, everybody! Do you love the utility of the Skill Rings mod, but find yourself wishing they fit in with the colors from your other Stardew Valley Recolors? Maybe you'd prefer if all of your foraging rings looked more similar to prevent confusion? Do you like it when I ask you rhetorical questions?

Well, you're in luck! Provided you've already downloaded Skill Rings (required!!) and installed it, you need only to download this, unzip the zip file, and place all the contents inside of the "Skill Rings Edit" folder into your mod folder where the matching SkillRings folder is. When you are asked, REPLACE FILES, et voila! New bling!

Should the original mod receive updates/versions with new rings, I plan to retexture those as well to match with what's here. PLEASE, PLEASE let me know if I've screwed up the file order in some way, I am incredibly new and have probably made a silly mistake somewheres. Also if you have a better name for this retexture I'm all ears.

CREDIT for the mod goes to AlphaMeece, thank you AlphaMeece for letting me post this.

[s]I'm on the SDV Discord, now! My name is Cetirizine and you can @ me if Skill Rings was updated, or even if you want help with textures for something you're making! I'm not a pro and I don't do large-scale things, but pixel art is a hobby of mine that is quite dear to me and I'd be happy to help with whatever I can.
[/s]I am no longer on the Discord for personal reasons and I'm on an extended break from Stardew Valley, but this is not abandoned! AlphaMeece sent me a PM to let me know they updated their mod and I do still plan to keep this up to date. It just takes me a while to notice these things.

Downloads.Description: Updated for the new file setup and additional generic rings! The installation is the same, please let me know if I got something wrong!
